notes: Interaction rows are served by the platform's interactions schema and carry the originating database in sourceDatabase, which is the edge type of the typed graph.
The interaction panel is the subset of the candidate pool present in at least 3 programmes; the paper does not publish its panel rule.
The interaction sweep is bounded at 120 queries and 240 s; 277 panel genes were left unqueried and 59 queries failed.

The interaction resolver returned no edge during the sweep, so the typed graph carries the annotation families only (programme membership, pathway membership, population attribution, compartment localisation, tractability annotation). Re-run the refresh path to populate the interaction family.
